title: AGENTS.md documents a test command that finds zero tests
body:
`AGENTS.md` is the first file every agent is told to read, and the test command it documents runs no tests.

## What it says, and what happens

`AGENTS.md` under "Test commands" documents:

```
bats tests/
```

`tests/` holds **zero** top-level `.bats` files. All **29** live under `tests/unit/`. `bats` is not recursive by default, so `bats tests/` finds nothing.

## Why this is medium and not high

**It fails honestly.** The command exits 1 and says it found no tests, so nothing green comes out of it -- this is a wrong instruction, not a false green, and it is the better of the two failure modes. It is filed because of WHERE it sits: `AGENTS.md` is the tool-agnostic contract, named first in `CLAUDE.md`, and read by every agentic CLI that opens this repository. An agent following it concludes the suite is empty or broken.

The working command is `bats tests/unit`, which returns **717/717, 0 failures, 2 self-declaring skips, rc 0**.

## The fix is NOT a hand edit

`AGENTS.md` is GENERATED -- `intent agents sync` writes it, and editing it directly is forbidden by `in-essentials` rule 2. The next sync overwrites any correction made here. That makes this partly an upstream question:

- if the test command comes from this project's Intent config, the fix is in the config and this is devbin's;
- if it comes from the template's default for a shell project, the fix is upstream in Intent and this issue is a report.

**Establish which before changing anything.** The same shape closed as issue 0029: a correction written into the region a regeneration overwrites is a delay, not a fix.

## Related

Same family as the exit-code contract issue filed alongside this one: prose that states a fact about the tool, in a file nothing tests, going quietly false while the tool moves.



## Closed 2026-09-14 -- fixed upstream, and measured here

**The command came from Intent's template, so the report was upstream's and so was the fix.** That was the question this issue said to settle before changing anything. Intent's `lib/templates/llm/_AGENTS.md` now carries `bats -r tests/`, and `intent claude upgrade --apply --skip-settings` wrote it into this repository at `900072c` (the Intent 3.0.2 carrier sweep). No hand edit was made here, so a regeneration keeps the fix rather than undoing it.

**The documented command now runs the whole suite.** Run as written, `bats -r tests/` from the project root on 2026-09-14: plan `1..1058`, 1058 ok, 0 not ok, rc 0 captured directly after bats rather than read off a wrapper, three skips each stating its own reason, and no stray output. HEAD read `6c43f91` when the run ended; the one commit that landed during it added two issue files and nothing under `lib/` or `tests/`.
